zh-CN.title: Frienden 新站上线
items: Frienden 主站和镜像现已可用，检查更新可查看四站版本
旧域名每周提示迁移，维护将于 2026 年 12 月 31 日结束，账号与数据不变

en.title: Frienden sites are live
items: The Frienden primary and mirror sites are ready; check versions across all four sites
Legacy domains show weekly migration reminders and end maintenance on December 31, 2026; your account and data stay the same
